privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.introduction: Yieldge is an enterprise technology consulting firm committed to responsible data stewardship. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, process, protect, and manage personal information in connection with our professional services, digital platforms, and business operations. We maintain governance practices designed to ensure transparency, accountability, and compliance with applicable privacy requirements.

informationCollect.title: Information We Collect
informationCollect.description: In the course of providing professional consulting and technology services, we may collect the following categories of information:

items.personal: Personal Information: Name, professional title, organizational affiliation, and other identifiers
items.contact: Contact Information: Email address, telephone number, mailing address, and professional contact details
items.business: Business Information: Company name, industry sector, organizational role, and engagement-related information
items.device: Device Information: Device type, operating system, browser type, and unique device identifiers
items.technical: Technical Information: IP address, access timestamps, referring URLs, and network configuration data
items.usage: Usage Information: Interaction patterns with our digital platforms, pages visited, features accessed, and session duration
items.communication: Communication Data: Content of correspondence, inquiries, and professional communications exchanged with our team

howWeUse.title: How We Use Information
howWeUse.description: We process information collected in connection with the following legitimate business purposes:

items.delivery: Service Delivery: Providing professional consulting, technology implementation, and advisory services
items.support: Client Support: Responding to inquiries, providing technical assistance, and maintaining engagement communications
items.security: Security: Protecting our systems, detecting unauthorized access, and maintaining platform integrity
items.compliance: Compliance: Meeting legal, regulatory, contractual, and audit obligations
items.communications: Communications: Delivering service updates, research publications, and professional insights
items.analytics: Analytics: Understanding service utilization patterns and improving platform functionality
items.improvement: Service Improvement: Enhancing service quality, developing new capabilities, and optimizing operational processes

dataGovernance.title: Data Governance
dataGovernance.description: Yieldge maintains governance practices designed to ensure responsible information management:

items.accountability: Accountability: Clear ownership and responsibility for information assets
items.traceability: Traceability: Documented processing activities and audit capabilities
items.access: Access Control: Role-based access restrictions and authorization procedures
items.stewardship: Information Stewardship: Defined processes for data quality, accuracy, and integrity
items.lifecycle: Lifecycle Management: Retention schedules aligned with business, legal, and regulatory requirements
items.responsible: Responsible Data Handling: Policies governing collection, processing, storage, and disposal of information

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.description: We implement commercially reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards designed to protect information under our control:

items.access: Access Controls: Role-based permissions and least-privilege access principles
items.authentication: Authentication Mechanisms: Identity verification and credential management procedures
items.encryption: Encryption Technologies: Protection of data in transit and at rest using industry-standard protocols
items.monitoring: Monitoring Systems: Security monitoring, threat detection, and incident alerting capabilities
items.audit: Audit Logging: Comprehensive logging of system access, changes, and security-relevant events

dataSecurity.disclaimer: However, no technology environment can guarantee absolute security. We cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information transmitted to us or stored on our systems.

informationSharing.title: Information Sharing
informationSharing.description: We limit information sharing to circumstances necessary for legitimate business operations:

items.serviceProviders: Service Providers: Trusted vendors who assist with business operations under appropriate contractual protections
items.cloudProviders: Cloud Providers: Infrastructure and platform providers supporting our technology operations
items.legal: Legal Requirements: Disclosure required by law, regulation, legal process, or governmental request
items.business: Business Operations: Professional advisors, auditors, and parties involved in corporate transactions

informationSharing.noSale: Yieldge does not sell personal information to third parties.

aiProcessing.title: Artificial Intelligence Processing
aiProcessing.description: Certain services may utilize artificial intelligence, machine learning, and automated processing technologies to support analysis, automation, information processing, and operational efficiency. These technologies are deployed in accordance with our responsible AI principles and applicable governance frameworks.

responsibleAI.title: Responsible AI Processing
responsibleAI.description: Customer information is not used to train public artificial intelligence models unless explicitly authorized in writing by the client. Any AI processing involving client data is performed in accordance with engagement-specific terms, confidentiality obligations, and applicable data protection requirements.

internationalTransfers.title: International Transfers
internationalTransfers.description: Yieldge and our trusted service providers may operate across multiple jurisdictions. When information is transferred internationally, we apply appropriate safeguards designed to ensure adequate protection consistent with applicable legal requirements and industry standards.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.description: We retain information only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, including to satisfy business, contractual, legal, regulatory, audit, and security requirements. Retention periods are determined based on the nature of the information, the purposes for processing, and applicable legal obligations. When information is no longer required, it is securely disposed of in accordance with our information governance procedures.

userRights.title: User Rights
userRights.description: Subject to applicable law, you may have the following rights regarding your personal information:

items.access: Access: Request information about the personal data we hold about you
items.correction: Correction: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal information
items.deletion: Deletion: Request deletion of personal information under certain circumstances
items.restriction: Restriction: Request restriction of processing in specific situations
items.clarification: Clarification: Request information about our data processing practices

userRights.exercise: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the information provided below. We will respond to requests in accordance with applicable legal requirements.

cookies.title: Cookies and Analytics
cookies.description: Our digital platforms may use cookies, web beacons, and similar technologies to enhance functionality, analyze usage patterns, and improve user experience. These technologies help us understand how visitors interact with our platforms and enable certain features to function properly.
cookies.management: You may configure your browser settings to manage cookie preferences. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect platform functionality and your experience with our services.

incidentResponse.title: Incident Response
incidentResponse.description: Yieldge maintains procedures designed to identify, investigate, contain, and respond to security incidents affecting personal information. In the event of a security incident requiring notification, we will inform affected parties and relevant authorities in accordance with applicable legal requirements and timeframes.

regulatoryCompliance.title: Regulatory Compliance
regulatoryCompliance.description: We are committed to compliance with applicable privacy, cybersecurity, and data protection requirements in the jurisdictions where we operate. Our privacy practices are designed to align with recognized standards and regulatory frameworks governing the protection of personal information.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.description: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our practices, technologies, legal requirements, or business operations. Material changes will be communicated by posting the revised policy on our website with an updated effective date. We encourage you to review this policy regularly.

contact.title: Contact Information
contact.description: For questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our data protection practices, please contact our Privacy Office at:

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.introduction: Yieldge is an enterprise technology consulting firm providing professional services in technology consulting, digital transformation, software engineering, enterprise architecture, systems integration, automation, artificial intelligence, data analytics, observability, and operational intelligence. These Terms of Service govern the use of our website, digital platforms, and professional services.

professionalServices.title: Nature of Professional Services
professionalServices.description: Yieldge provides professional consulting, software engineering, systems integration, digital transformation, automation, artificial intelligence, observability, data analytics, and technology advisory services. All services are delivered using commercially reasonable skill, care, and diligence consistent with generally accepted industry practices.
professionalServices.noGuarantees: Except as expressly stated in a written agreement, Yieldge does not guarantee any specific business outcome, operational improvement, financial result, cost reduction, revenue increase, regulatory approval, or strategic objective.

professionalJudgment.title: Independent Professional Judgment
professionalJudgment.description: Any recommendation, assessment, architecture, implementation strategy, report, analysis, or technological guidance provided by Yieldge represents professional opinion based upon information available at the time of engagement.
professionalJudgment.disclaimer: Such guidance shall not be construed as legal, financial, tax, audit, or regulatory advice. Clients should consult appropriate professionals for matters requiring specialized legal, financial, or regulatory expertise.

items.accurate: Providing accurate, complete, and timely information necessary for the performance of services
items.review: Reviewing deliverables, reports, and outputs in a timely manner
items.validate: Validating that deliverables meet requirements and are fit for intended purposes
items.approvals: Obtaining and maintaining all necessary internal approvals, authorizations, and consents
items.compliance: Ensuring compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies

decisionResponsibility.title: Client Decision Responsibility
decisionResponsibility.description: The client retains sole responsibility for all business, operational, financial, legal, cybersecurity, compliance, and strategic decisions made based upon services, recommendations, reports, analyses, software, deliverables, or information provided by Yieldge. Yieldge provides professional guidance to inform decision-making but does not make decisions on behalf of the client.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.description: Yieldge retains exclusive ownership of all intellectual capital, methodologies, frameworks, processes, templates, accelerators, software components, automation assets, artificial intelligence systems, analytical models, prompts, agent systems, reference architectures, trade secrets, and know-how used, developed, enhanced, or utilized in connection with the provision of services.

deliverables.title: Ownership of Deliverables
deliverables.description: Upon full payment of applicable fees, the client shall own project-specific deliverables expressly developed for the client under the applicable agreement, subject to any third-party license terms that may apply to incorporated components.
deliverables.retained: Yieldge retains ownership of all generic, reusable, pre-existing, or independently developed assets incorporated into such deliverables, including methodologies, frameworks, templates, software libraries, and intellectual property developed prior to or independently of the engagement.

retainedKnowledge.title: Retained Knowledge
retainedKnowledge.description: Nothing contained in any agreement shall restrict Yieldge from using general knowledge, experience, skills, concepts, methodologies, techniques, and know-how acquired during the course of providing services, provided that no confidential information of the client is disclosed. Yieldge may develop and provide similar services to other clients.

confidentiality.title: Confidentiality
confidentiality.description: Both parties agree to protect confidential information using reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards appropriate to the nature of the information.
confidentiality.definition: Confidential information includes information belonging to either party that would reasonably be considered confidential, proprietary, sensitive, or commercially valuable, including business strategies, technical specifications, client data, pricing information, and trade secrets.

security.title: Security and Information Protection
security.description: Yieldge implements commercially reasonable safeguards designed to protect information under its control, including:
security.disclaimer: However, no technology environment can guarantee absolute security. Yieldge shall not be liable for security incidents resulting from factors beyond its reasonable control.

aiServices.title: Artificial Intelligence Services
aiServices.disclaimer: Outputs generated by such technologies may contain inaccuracies, omissions, hallucinations, biases, or incomplete information.
aiServices.review: Human review and validation remain essential. Clients should independently verify AI-generated outputs before relying upon them for business decisions.

responsibleAI.title: Responsible Artificial Intelligence
responsibleAI.description: Yieldge promotes responsible artificial intelligence practices grounded in:

items.transparency: Transparency regarding AI capabilities and limitations
items.accountability: Accountability for AI system behavior and outcomes
items.oversight: Human Oversight of automated processes and decisions
items.explainability: Explainability of AI-driven recommendations where feasible
items.traceability: Traceability of AI processing and decision logic
items.risk: Risk Management proportionate to AI system impact

responsibleAI.augment: Artificial intelligence systems are intended to augment human decision-making and do not replace professional judgment, governance processes, or appropriate human oversight.

governance.title: Digital Governance, Observability and Traceability
governance.disclaimer: Such capabilities improve organizational awareness and governance maturity but do not guarantee the identification, prevention, or elimination of all operational, compliance, fraud, cybersecurity, or business risks. Effective risk management requires comprehensive programs beyond technology solutions.

thirdParty.title: Third Party Platforms
thirdParty.disclaimer: Yieldge shall not be responsible for outages, interruptions, policy changes, service limitations, security incidents, or failures attributable to third-party providers beyond its reasonable control.

noReliance.title: No Reliance by Third Parties
noReliance.description: Deliverables, recommendations, reports, assessments, and services are intended exclusively for the client identified in the applicable engagement. No third party may rely upon such materials without Yieldge's prior written consent. Yieldge assumes no duty or liability to any third party in connection with services provided to a client.

warranties.description: Except as expressly set forth in a written agreement, Yieldge disclaims all warranties, whether express, implied, statutory, or otherwise, including warranties of:

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.description: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Yieldge shall not be liable for:
liability.cap: Yieldge's aggregate liability for any and all claims arising out of or relating to services shall not exceed the fees actually paid by the client to Yieldge during the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim.

forceMajeure.title: Force Majeure
forceMajeure.description: Yieldge shall not be liable for delays or failures in performance resulting from causes beyond its reasonable control, including acts of God, natural disasters, pandemic, war, terrorism, civil unrest, government action, labor disputes, power outages, telecommunications failures, or third-party service disruptions.

items.question: Is there any cost to message on WhatsApp?
items.answer: No. The first conversation is completely free. Our goal is to understand your situation, answer your questions, and help you determine the best path for your business.

items.question: What happens after I contact you?
items.answer: First, we'll learn about your business, goals, and current challenges. If we can add value, we'll prepare a personalized proposal with a clear strategy, scope, and investment tailored to your needs.

items.question: How much does a project cost?
items.answer: It depends on scope and your company's needs. In the free assessment we give you a transparent range with no commitment, so you can evaluate the return before deciding.

items.question: Do I own the website or is it rented?
items.answer: It's 100% yours. The code, domain, and content belong to you. You decide how to manage it going forward.

items.question: What if I already have a website?
items.answer: We start with an audit. In many cases we optimize what exists; sometimes a strategic redesign delivers better ROI. We'll tell you honestly in the assessment.

items.question: Do you only work with clinics?
items.answer: No. We work with clinics, businesses, independent professionals, and organizations looking to strengthen their digital presence and attract more clients.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: Most projects are delivered within four to six weeks, with a defined timeline and constant communication throughout.

items.question: Why message on WhatsApp instead of filling out a form?
items.answer: Because it's the fastest way to get guidance. In just a few minutes we can understand your situation, answer your questions, and honestly tell you if we're the right team.
